leadText:
A Furisode Girl (Japanese: ふりそで Furisode) is a type of Pokémon Trainer introduced in Generation VI. They are depicted as young girls and young women wearing black, blue, pink and purple, or white . They also appear in the Battle Chateau, although they are classed as es and es, and exclusively use teams of . 

In the Battle Maison, Furisode Girls typically use any of 's Evolutions. In , Furisode Girls exclusively use Pokémon, with most using at least one .

===Pokémon Masters EX===
Main articles: Kali (Masters), Katherine (Masters), Blossom (Masters), and Linnea (Masters)
Furisode Girls Kali, , Blossom and Linnea form sync pairs with , , , and , respectively, in Pokémon Masters EX. Kali became a playable sync pair on January 1, 2023, Katherine became a playable sync pair on January 1, 2024, Blossom became a playable sync pair on January 3, 2025, and Linnea became a playable sync pair on January 1, 2026.

Several Furisode Girls, including Valerie's Gym Trainers from the , debuted alongside Valerie in A Fashionable Battle!, performing at a fashion show. Some of them reappeared in the next episode, following 's Gym battle with Valerie. The Furisode Girls perfectly resembled their game counterparts.

==Trivia==
In the Battle Chateau, Furisode Girl Yolande mentions that her outfit costs about 200 Big Nuggets, which equates to about 2,000,000 in Generation VI.
